title: agentfs change-stream record
description: One line of the NDJSON stream agentfs watch emits under --format ndjson. Each line is a complete JSON object; the stream as a whole is not one. kind selects the shape of data.

schema.description: The record format the line declares.

kind.description: What the record reports, which selects the shape of data.

seq.description: The producer's record ordinal, counting from 1, so a gap names a record the consumer did not receive.

time.description: The instant the record reports, RFC 3339 with its offset.

dedup_key.description: The identity of the event the record reports, absent for a record that reports no repeatable event.

data.description: The payload kind selects, absent for a record that carries none.
